title: Leif Bloomquist - Updates to Commodore 64 and Retro Multiplayer Roguelike Development
speaker: Leif Bloomquist
talk_title: Updates to Commodore 64 and Retro Multiplayer Roguelike Development
description:
This talk is from the 2019 Roguelike Celebration - find out more at https://roguelike.club/event2019.html

Leif Bloomquist has been experimenting with technology, games, and music since the days of the Commodore 64. He dabbles in retrocomputing, wearable technology, open-source hardware, and gaming. By day he is a senior engineer at MDA, a Canadian aerospace company developing the future of space robotics.
